title: Show failed tests and panic text in introspection failed checks
summary: In introspect.rs, each failed check in the introspection input will list its failed_tests names. Its excerpt will come from the cargo `failures:` section, or from the output before the CI post-job cleanup lines, instead of the raw last 600 characters. The audience is the introspection model, which wrongly said no failing test was named.

defaults_applied.how: Criteria require new tests plus passing fmt, clippy and cargo test.
Criteria assert on the rendered input text, not on wiring.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Code survey: read crates/athena-core/src/introspect.rs (TAIL_CAP at 949, clip_tail at 962, failed-check section at 1109-1122, test helper at ~2143 building a check with failed_tests empty) and the check type in crates/athena-core/src/ci_result.rs (failed_tests: Vec<String> at line 98, output_tail at 100). No record or data file is added, so check_record_file and AnyRecord are unaffected. The property is measured directly by rendering the input text and asserting on it.

Cleanup markers are GitHub runner lines such as 'Post job cleanup.' and the 'Node.js 20 actions are deprecated' warning. The producer picks a small marker list. If there is no `failures:` section and no marker, fall back to the old clip_tail behaviour.
The request lists verification.json as a file, but it is a record. It is not changed. The only deliverable is introspect.rs, plus the default CHANGELOG.md entry.
No governance files, workflows or prompts change. The introspection system prompt is untouched.

acceptance_criteria.text: A new unit test in crates/athena-core/src/introspect.rs builds a failed check whose output_tail has a cargo `failures:` section with a panic line, then CI cleanup lines (post-job cleanup and a Node.js 20 warning), and whose failed_tests is non-empty. It asserts the rendered input names each failed test and its panic line and contains no cleanup lines. Run `cargo test -p athena-core introspect`.
A new unit test shows a failed check with empty failed_tests and plain output still renders its tail, clipped to TAIL_CAP. Run `cargo test -p athena-core introspect`.

The failed-check loop in introspect.rs no longer passes the raw output_tail to clip_tail alone. It prints the failed_tests names and builds the excerpt from the `failures:` section, or from the text before the cleanup lines. A diff line shows this.
The existing introspect tests pass, including the one at ~3042 that checks the tail is clipped to TAIL_CAP. Run `cargo test`.
cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets and cargo test all pass. Athena's recorded checks on the final tree count as evidence.
CHANGELOG.md has a new entry for this change, and no other file under records/ or docs/decisions.md is edited.

out_of_scope: Changing how CI results are captured or stored (ci_result.rs, verification.json records)
Changing the introspection system prompt or other sections of the input (criteria, findings)
